$comment: Mirrors agreement.schema.json's approach: one JSON schema is the only declaration of this shape. The TS type is generated from it (src/generated/schemas.d.ts) and FALLBACK is this file's examples[0].

hi.$comment: x-index-into is scoped to the CONTAINING OBJECT, not the schema root: each integer in this `hi` array indexes the `tokens` array of the same steps[] item it lives in. The Ruby post-pass (Task 7) that resolves x-index-into must walk the value against its containing object, not against a document-level `tokens`.
